response.sql: SELECT team_id, total_games, total_games::NUMERIC / SUM(total_games) OVER () as fraction_of_total, total_games::NUMERIC / AVG(total_games) OVER () as ratio_to_average FROM (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) team_totals ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
